title: backlog.py new bug prints the repro's last output lines, so the filer sees the failure is the defect it names
goal: backlog.py new bug runs the repro once (it already must fail now) and prints its last output lines beside the new id, so a worker sees a repro that fails for another reason before it hands back (SP-s2svf5a6 close: BG-y5r5a3ht's repro copied only _tools, failed on kbcommon listdir(KB_DIR) instead of the missing kb/_self it named, and was dropped once ST-pdtcxbap fixed the real defect)

run:
import os, subprocess, sys, tempfile
d = tempfile.mkdtemp()
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "_tools/backlog.py", "--root", d, "new", "bug", "--title", "t", "--goal", "g", "--severity", "S3", "--repro", "python3 -c 'import sys; print(\"FileNotFoundError: kb\", file=sys.stderr); sys.exit(1)'"], capture_output=True, text=True)
out = p.stdout + p.stderr
print(out[-400:])
sys.exit(0 if "FileNotFoundError: kb" in out else 1)
